docbuild.models.config.env.EnvRemote
====================================

.. py:class:: docbuild.models.config.env.EnvRemote(/, **data: Any)

   Bases: :py:obj:`pydantic.BaseModel`

   .. autoapi-inheritance-diagram:: docbuild.models.config.env.EnvRemote
      :parts: 1


   Defines the remote destination for publishing built documentation.


   .. py:attribute:: model_config

      Configuration for the model, should be a dictionary conforming to [`ConfigDict`][pydantic.config.ConfigDict].



   .. py:attribute:: server
      :type:  SSHEndpoint | None
      :value: None


      The SSH server endpoint (``user@host`` or ``host``) used by publish, or None.



   .. py:attribute:: path
      :type:  docbuild.models.path.AbsolutePath | None
      :value: None


      The absolute remote directory used by publish, or None.
